approve.label: Approve it
approve.say: Say approve to let {who} go ahead.

remove_leftover_unit.label: Remove the leftover
remove_leftover_unit.say: Ask me to remove the leftover {label} service.

open_stream.label: Open the stream
open_stream.say: Ask me to open {code} in QuoxPlan.

decide.label: Make the decision
decide.say: Tell me your decision on {code} and I will record it.

reply.label: Reply
reply.say: Tell me what to say back and I will draft the reply.

show_log.label: Show the log
show_log.say: Ask me to show the log.

retry_build.label: Run the build again
retry_build.say: Ask me to run the {target} build again.

investigate.label: Look into it
investigate.say: Ask me to look into it.

send_session_message.label: Send it a message
send_session_message.say: Tell me what to send to {label}.

open_contacts_sync.label: Open the sync settings
open_contacts_sync.say: Open ContactsQ, then Settings, then Sync, and re-enable the connection.

open_contacts_compliance.label: Open the compliance view
open_contacts_compliance.say: Open ContactsQ, then Compliance, to see the retention status.

open_contacts_review.label: Review the candidates
open_contacts_review.say: Open ContactsQ to keep or discard the waiting candidates.

open_matrix_board.label: Open the Proof Matrix board
open_matrix_board.say: Open the Proof Matrix board to see every job and its proof.

open_gripe.label: Open the gripe
open_gripe.say: Open the gripe to read it.
